subject: Test of methylation variability between groups, as in diffVar of missMethyl

messages.author: 610482f6c83ca4be
messages.subject: Test of methylation variability between groups, as in diffVar of missMethyl
parts:
Hello,

I have a RRBS data from 2 groups of 6 samples (6 mothers and 6 daughters, genetically related one-to-one).
I was wondering if there is a way to compare the variability in methylation of all CpGs between the two groups just with methylKit, similar to what is proposed by diffVar function of missMethyl.
In fact, my hypothesis is that one group should show higher variability in methylation, no matter the mean methylation level or the significance of methylation differences.

Thank you in advance for any suggestion,

tom

did you try using diffVar on methylation values ? maybe that works. I have never used missMethyl but if that is something works on the beta values on the scale of 0 to 1, it might work for methylation ratios/percentages you get from methylKit

Best,
altuna
